svg.title: Sentinel — Integrated video management and analytics
svg.desc: Sentinel: Integrated video management and analytics. One platform over 26 departments' CCTV systems without changing any of them: a single camera registry with GIS, continuous ANPR and video analytics, watchlist alerts, and a vehicle's complete timestamped route from one registration number. Video becomes permanent only where a logged watchlist match justifies it. Pipeline: Camera registry, Stream ingest, Detect and track, Read plates, Watchlist match, Route rebuild. 58 cameras onboarded across 5 departments. 119 MiB peak GPU memory, YOLOX-S on a GTX 1650. 0 restarts in the measured live window. 80,000 cameras the design is sized for. Measured on the live government sandbox feed on one laptop.
